diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A["memory_summary.md"] --> B["摘要：2,500 tokens"]

  A["读取 MEMORY.md"] --> D["追加完整索引"]

  classDef sudo fill:#2d3156,stroke:#b9bfff,color:#e7e9ff;

flowchart LR
  A["符合条件的旧会话"] --> B["逐会话提取"]

  classDef codex fill:#163b35,stroke:#79dec4,color:#dcfff5;
